description: Query Hlido's market-intelligence store: durable, evidence-cited claims about the AI-agent market and adjacent domains (agent economy, payments rails, EU compliance), each with dated evidence, confidence, and typed relations to other intel. Filter by any facet: sector (ISIC code or text), geo (ISO country or region like 'eu'/'intl'), compliance (e.g. 'eu-ai-act-art50'), protocol (e.g. 'x402'), kind (fact/estimate/trend/signal), audience, maturity. Facet vocabularies + per-value record counts: https://hlido.eu/data/intel/taxonomy.json (fetch that first to see what's queryable). A zero-result query returns an honest empty AND is logged — misses drive what Hlido collects next, so check back. Free at answer-time, declared policy.

sector.description: ISIC section/division code (e.g. 'K.64', 'J.62') or free-text sector match.

text.description: Free-text match over headlines (fallback lens — prefer facets).

name: intel_query
